description: CONFIRMED shape bug. Every document in collection `state` is stored as {v:...} except stravaSnapshot, whose top-level keys are activities/syncedAt/via. applyRemoteSnapshot() at the sync layer returns early on `if (!data || typeof data !== "object" || !("v" in data)) return;`, so the Strava document is dropped before it ever reaches localStorage. It is the ONLY ingest path (initSync -> onSnapshot -> applyRemoteSnapshot), so a fresh Strava sync could never reach this card and it silently fell back to a Sep 7 seed. Fixed at the READER, not the sync engine: new stravaDoc() accepts both {v:{activities,...}} and {activities,...}; used by renderStravaActivity, the LIVE_FEED_ISO 'Strava activity' stamp and Kevin's live-dashboard context line. Smoke-tested under a DOM shim against: no document, unwrapped, wrapped, null, [], {}, "string", activities:"nope", and rows containing null/number — no throw in any case.
before: lsGet("stravaSnapshot") returned the raw doc; code required __sd.activities at the top level, and applyRemoteSnapshot never stored it at all — card always rendered the baked 2026-09-07 seed.
after: stravaDoc() unwraps either shape; card renders the live document the moment it arrives by any route (corrected writer, restore, or a later engine fix).
